behavior: dotf vault work <family> <component> scaffolds 50_work/45-development/<family>/<component>/{00-context.md,memory/MEMORY.md} with tokens substituted, plus the parent <family>/00-context.md create-if-absent
Component files skip-if-present and regenerate under --force; a missing vault is an error naming $VAULT_PATH (not a silent skip)
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/vault -run 'TestWriteWorkEntrySkipsExistingThenForceRegenerates|TestResolveVaultStrictErrorsWhenAbsent' && go test ./internal/cmd -run 'TestVaultWorkErrorsWhenVaultAbsent|TestVaultWorkForceFlagPlumbed'

behavior: Embedded work-sdk-*.md templates are byte-identical to the vault SSOT (drift guard runs real where the vault is present, skips where absent)
dotf vault parent is a first-class Available Command (runnable via cmd.Help), listed by dotf --help, with the work subcommand under it
family/component path arguments are validated against traversal/injection (../, .., path separators rejected before any write)
